Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding enrollment calculations for certain K-12 programs.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to calculating fulltime equivalent enrollment forcertain K12 programs based on a threeyear average of annualenrollment; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.150 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.150RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of appropriation and allocation of state fundsto school districts, the office of the superintendent of publicinstruction shall calculate annual average fulltime equivalent studentenrollment as provided in this section. (2) For the following allocations, the calculation of annualaverage fulltime equivalent student enrollment for a school year shallbe based on a threeyear average comprising the annual average fulltime equivalent student enrollment in the school year for which thecalculation is made and the annual average fulltime equivalent studentenrollment in the prior two school years: (a) Beginning with the allocations for the 200910 school year:The basic education allocation under RCW 28A.150.260 and allocations p. 1 HB 1558for the program for highly capable students under chapter 28A.185 RCW;and (b) Beginning with the allocations for the 201011 school year:Allocations based on annual average fulltime equivalent studentenrollments in the prior school year calculated as provided under thissubsection (2) from the student achievement fund under RCW 28A.505.220and for the learning assistance program under chapter 28A.165 RCW. (3) For the following allocations and any, unless otherwisespecified, other allocations of funds based on fulltime equivalentstudent enrollment, the calculation of annual average fulltimeequivalent student enrollment for a school year shall be based onenrollment in the school year for which the calculation is made: Thespecial education excess cost allocation under RCW 28A.150.390 andallocations for educational programs for students in residentialschools under chapter 28A.190 RCW.
